prompt.es: Escribe una verificación de 130–250 palabras con tres afirmaciones y un veredicto.

answer.text: I checked the viral story about the school closing, and I rate it as unproven. First, the post says the council has cut the budget in half, but it comes from an account with no name and gives no source, so we cannot confirm it. Second, the photo of the empty building is real, but it is misleading, because it was taken during last year's summer holidays, out of context. Third, the headline says most families have left, but it is based on a survey of only ten families, so it is a hasty generalisation. There is no evidence that the school will close, and the original source is missing. To find out more, we need the council's official report and the real number of students. Based on the evidence available, the story is likely to be false, although we may be wrong if new figures appear. In conclusion, readers should not share it until a reliable source confirms it.
accepted: I checked the viral story about the school closing, and I rate it as unproven. First, the post says the council has cut the budget in half, but it comes from an account with no name and gives no source, so we cannot confirm it. Second, the photo of the empty building is real, but it is misleading, because it was taken during last year's summer holidays, out of context. Third, the headline says most families have left, but it is based on a survey of only ten families, so it is a hasty generalisation. There is no evidence that the school will close, and the original source is missing. To find out more, we need the council's official report and the real number of students. Based on the evidence available, the story is likely to be false, although we may be wrong if new figures appear. In conclusion, readers should not share it until a reliable source confirms it.

My verdict on the viral story is that it is unproven. The first claim, that the council has cut the budget in half, has no source, so we cannot confirm it. The second claim uses a real photo of the empty building, but it is misleading, because the photo shows the summer holidays and not a closed school. The third claim, that most families have left, comes from a survey of only ten families, which is too small a sample. There is no evidence that the school will close. We still need the original source and the official figures from the council. Based on the evidence available, the story is likely to be false, but it may change if new evidence appears. In conclusion, please do not share it yet.

feedback.es: Una verificación completa califica cada afirmación con su razón, señala la evidencia que falta y concluye con cautela.

origin.text: Historia viral: «El colegio cierra el próximo año». 1) Un post de una cuenta sin nombre dice que el consejo ha recortado el presupuesto a la mitad. 2) Una foto muestra el edificio vacío. 3) Un titular dice que la mayoría de las familias se ha marchado. Datos: el post no cita fuente; la foto es de las vacaciones de verano del año pasado; el titular se basa en una encuesta de diez familias. Redacta una verificación de 130–250 palabras: evalúa las tres afirmaciones, indica qué evidencia falta y termina con un veredicto matizado.
